day_debate.speaker: Nhan
day_debate.statement: Hoang's Seer confirmation is crucial. Cong's eagerness to validate his own claim and immediately deflect suspicion onto Nam is a blatant attempt to manipulate the discussion. I believe Cong is a Werewolf.
